title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the PIT Predicate
statement: The Boolean function on finite bit strings that sends each string $z$ to the one-bit string whose bit is $	exttt{pitW}(z)$ is computable by a deterministic Turing machine in time $C(n+1)^c$ on every input of length $n$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
hypotheses_covered: There exist a finite-state deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
There exist natural-number constants C and c
On every input, the machine halts within C(n+1)^c steps and outputs the one-bit string [pitW(z)]
